prompt: Manage lead data in Google Sheets: read existing tabs, append and correct lead rows, enrich contacts, detect duplicate email addresses, highlight duplicate rows, and attempt to prepare leads for import into an Instantly campaign.

results.use_case: Manage lead data in Google Sheets: read existing tabs, append and correct lead rows, enrich contacts, detect duplicate email addresses, highlight duplicate rows, and attempt to prepare leads for import into an Instantly campaign.
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: Optional (if list_id unknown) [Prerequisite]: Find the target list using INSTANTLY_LIST_LEAD_LISTS (resolve list_id by name/metadata).
Optional (if list ambiguity or high impact) [Prerequisite]: Confirm list details using INSTANTLY_GET_LEAD_LIST (avoid enriching the wrong list).
Required [Step]: Create the destination lead list using INSTANTLY_CREATE_LEAD_LIST (container for enriched leads).
Optional (if you want filter/volume sanity-check) [Prerequisite]: Estimate matches using INSTANTLY_COUNT_LEADS_FROM_SUPERSEARCH (validate expected result size).
Required [Step]: Create the SuperSearch enrichment job using INSTANTLY_CREATE_SUPERSEARCH_ENRICHMENT (bind filters + target list).
Optional (if verification/enrichment options need adjustment) [Next Step]: Update configuration using INSTANTLY_PATCH_SUPERSEARCH_ENRICHMENT_SETTINGS (ensure “verified email” intent before running).
Required [Step]: Start processing using INSTANTLY_SUPERSEARCH_ENRICHMENT_RUN_POST (execute the enrichment run).
Optional (to confirm completion or debug failed starts) [Next Step]: Check job status/results using INSTANTLY_GET_SUPERSEARCH_ENRICHMENT (verify completion and output).
known_pitfalls: [INSTANTLY_CREATE_SUPERSEARCH_ENRICHMENT] Requires a valid target list_id; binding the wrong list enriches the wrong destination.
[INSTANTLY_SUPERSEARCH_ENRICHMENT_RUN_POST] Run requests can fail if the job is not in a runnable/configured state—inspect with INSTANTLY_GET_SUPERSEARCH_ENRICHMENT when runs don’t start.
[INSTANTLY_PATCH_SUPERSEARCH_ENRICHMENT_SETTINGS] Only supported settings are patchable; changes to non-patchable fields may be ignored—recreate via INSTANTLY_CREATE_SUPERSEARCH_ENRICHMENT if needed.
[INSTANTLY_LIST_LEAD_LISTS] Similar list names can be hard to disambiguate from list output alone—confirm via INSTANTLY_GET_LEAD_LIST before binding enrichment.
